transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I have an intense, overwhelming fear of animals, especially dogs. It has gotten to the point where it is really affecting my daily life, and I knew I needed to seek some help for it.
When you’re around dogs or even think you might encounter one, do you immediately feel intense fear or panic and try to avoid the situation?

Yes, absolutely. Just thinking about the possibility of running into a dog makes me extremely anxious, and if I actually see one, I panic immediately. I do everything I can to completely avoid any places where I might encounter them, like parks or certain walking paths.
How long have you had this fear of dogs, and has it been present for at least 6 months?
Yes, I have had this intense fear of dogs for about 10 months now. So it has definitely been going on for well over 6 months.
How much is this fear interfering with your daily life, like work, school, errands, or seeing other people?

It interferes with my life a lot because I've had to severely restrict my daily routines and social activities just to avoid any chance of seeing a dog. I won't visit friends who have pets, and I even turn down social plans if they are outdoors in public spaces. I basically arrange my entire schedule and where I go around making sure I don't run into one.
